name: Score
title: A richer score sheet for CKMud
description: Rewrites the Ki/GodKi/BioMass/Heat percentages on `score` into real numbers and adds damage at every boost level, item tier, heal, training hints and gauntlet runs, plus gravity on the prompt. Needs the MSDP package. Type `sc help`.
author: fried

aliases.name: sc
aliases.script:
if matches[2] == "update" then return CKMudUpdate("Score") end
local function arg(s) if s and s ~= "" then return s end end
sc.command(arg(matches[2]), arg(matches[3]))
